gloss: to illuminate; to shine on; to compare

definitions.explanation: To direct light onto something, making it visible.
To verify or examine something by comparing it with a reference.

examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}が{海|うみ}を{照|て}らす。
examples.english: The sun shines on the sea.

examples.japanese: スポットライトが{舞台|ぶたい}を{照|て}らす。
{月|つき}が{道|みち}を{明|あか}るく{照|て}らしていて、{懐中電灯|かいちゅうでんとう}がなくても{歩|ある}けた。
examples.english: The moon was brightly illuminating the road, so I could walk even without a flashlight.

examples.japanese: {原文|げんぶん}と{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる。
データを{過去|かこ}の{記録|きろく}と{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせてください。
examples.english: Please compare the data against past records.

examples.japanese: {法律|ほうりつ}に{照|て}らして{考|かんが}えると、この{契約|けいやく}には{問題|もんだい}がある。
examples.english: Considering it in light of the law, there is a problem with this contract.

notes:
{照|て}らす is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pair: {照|て}る (intransitive - to shine)
- Pattern: Xが〜を{照|て}らす

ASPECT ({ている}):
{照|て}らしている indicates ongoing illumination.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {月|つき}が{照|て}らす (the moon illuminates)
- {太陽|たいよう}が{照|て}らす (the sun shines on)
- {照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to compare, check against)
- 〜に{照|て}らして (in light of ~, considering ~)

The compound {照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる is commonly used when verifying documents or comparing information.
